description: This file defines a utility function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes raw cost records to produce a dataset suitable for visualization in Recharts, grouping by agent and another dimension (e.g., environment or cost category), with zero-filling for missing categories across agents.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a grouped dataset with consistent categories and agents for visualization, ensuring zero-filled categories across agents.
